Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added North American destinations separated from Japanese destinations. Direct travel and datacentre bargain trips now include Japan/North America region selectors. Universalis Prices now includes a Price region selector for Japan or North America and uses Universalis' North-America API region for NA results.
